articleTitle: Does Blending Leafy Greens Retain the Same Nutrients?
imageHeadline: Blending Greens Keeps the Fiber & Nutrients
imageSubtext: What actually changes when you drink spinach instead of chewing it
pinTitle: Does Blending Leafy Greens Retain Nutrients? What the Research Shows
pinDescription: Blending spinach or kale into a smoothie keeps the fiber, vitamins, and minerals intact—unlike juicing, which strains out what matters. Learn what you gain in volume, what you lose in satiety, and how to make blended greens work without overthinking it.
backgroundScene: A glass blender jar filled with fresh green leafy vegetables and clear liquid, sitting on a kitchen counter with scattered spinach leaves nearby
